reasoning: Three horizontal lines paired with a play triangle is the standard UI glyph for a playlist or media queue. It fits real-life tasks around curating music mixes for events, workouts, and trips, or managing video/podcast queues, though at a quick glance it resembles text-alignment or indentation icons.
